note: The probe first reported work_key MISSING. That was the PROBE being wrong, not the model: s09_cards keys the reply on o["i"] (line 240) and assigns work_key from the batch itself, so the extractor never emits it. Same class as handbook 7.3 -- a check disagreeing with the artifact is a suspect until you know which is wrong.
caveat: A JSON-shape probe proves ONE object parses. It does not prove comparable recall over a full month (2.1). glm-5.3-flash has no measured track record here; qwen3.8-flash carries 3129 verified anchors across eight shipped months.
